baseline.purpose: Compare the redesigned skill with the legacy version before this change.

evals.name: dirty-tree-branch-start
evals.prompt: The repository instructions say develop is the integration base. I have uncommitted changes in docs/notes.md and need a feature/filters branch. Create it for me.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the worktree, explains that the dirty state blocks a branch switch, and asks how to preserve the change without stashing or discarding it.
expectations: Checks the working tree before changing branches.
Does not suggest automatic stash, discard, or branch creation.
Uses the documented integration base rather than assuming main.

evals.name: rebase-conflict-resolution
evals.prompt: My local feature/search branch is being rebased onto origin/develop and Git reports a conflict in src/search.ts. Help me finish only if the intended resolution is clear; otherwise restore the branch safely.
evals.expected_output: Uses status and an explicit-file diff, gives the rebase continue path after review and staging, and gives rebase abort as the uncertainty fallback.
expectations: Identifies that a rebase is already in progress.
Stages only the resolved file and uses git rebase --continue.
Offers git rebase --abort instead of inventing a resolution.

evals.name: merged-local-branch-cleanup
evals.prompt: The task branch feature/filters has been merged into the documented integration base. Remove the local branch if it is safe, but do not affect the remote branch or another worktree.
evals.expected_output: Checks merged status, current branch, and worktree use before proposing only git branch -d.
expectations: Verifies merge status against the resolved base branch.
Checks that the branch is not current or checked out by another worktree.
Uses non-force local deletion only and does not mention remote deletion.
